title: Meteorologists were central to D-Day. 'Pressure' tells the story of navigating uncertainty
summary: The new movie, based on writer and actor David Haig's 2014 play, dramatizes the tensions between military leaders and meteorologists in the lead up to the Allied invasion of Normandy.
